lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical stripes; spacing is narrowest at the cervical transition and increases in width across the mid-abdominal section.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the third stripe from the posterior, splitting near the dorsal line; a secondary merging of segments is visible on the fifth stripe in the upper-mid torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first two anterior stripes are abbreviated, terminating above the mid-lateral line; the final posterior stripe is fragmented into three vertically aligned dashes.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 8-10 high-contrast white spots located on the lateral posterior haunch and upper hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots align in a semi-connected horizontal geometric line on the lower flank, positioned beneath the tenth and eleventh vertical stripes.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white facial chevron markings and a distinct white patch at the ventral-cervical junction.
